Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring headlight use at all times during the fall and winter months.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to use of vehicle headlights; and amending RCW46.37.020.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.37.020 and 1977 ex.s. c 355 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every vehicle upon a highway within this state at any time from ahalf hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise ((and)), at anyother time when, due to insufficient light or unfavorable atmosphericconditions, persons and vehicles on the highway are not clearlydiscernible at a distance of one thousand feet ahead, and at all timesfrom two o'clock a.m. Pacific Standard Time on the last Sunday inOctober until two o'clock a.m. Pacific Standard Time on the firstSunday in April, shall display lighted headlights, other lights, andilluminating devices as hereinafter respectively required for differentclasses of vehicles, subject to exceptions with respect to parkedvehicles, and such stop lights, turn signals, and other signalingdevices shall be lighted as prescribed for the use of such devices.
